scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: Debugging means finding and repairing the cause of a problem. The first add-two action should change one into three, so the earliest mismatch is already at that step. A correct-looking final label cannot repair an incorrect action inside the method.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: The team changes the mistaken add-one instruction to add two, then runs the whole trace again. They also test a starting value of zero and an earlier successful example. A repair should fix the reported problem without silently breaking cases that used to work.
